title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance: Callout Counts at Which a Subscription Is Reviewed or Suspended
content:
Each Keyturn Roadside Assistance plan carries two figures counted in callouts over a rolling year: the
number of callouts that puts the subscription in front of a reviewer, and the number of callouts after
which cover is suspended.

| Plan | Callouts in a rolling year that put the subscription in front of a reviewer | Callouts in a rolling year after which cover is suspended |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover | 4 | 6 |
| Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover | 6 | 9 |
| Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover | 8 | 12 |
| Keyturn Roadside EV Cover | 8 | 12 |
| Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover | 16 | 24 |
| Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover | 14 | 20 |

### Notes on the figures

1. On every one of the six plans the suspension figure stands above the review figure.
2. Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover and Keyturn Roadside EV Cover carry the same pair, 8 and 12.
3. The highest pair is carried by Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover, at 16 and 24, which stands above
   Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover at 14 and 20; the lowest by Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover, at 4
   and 6.
